data.text:
[6:15AM] #LagAbkExpWay
#AbuleEgba
#TrafficUpdate
Good vehicular movement from Pleasure inward Ile epo to Super down connecting the Jubilee bridge at Abule egba.

 There's a broken down vehicle underneath the Jubilee bridge that occupied 50% of the road inward Oja.
Connecting Charity junction is fair considering the traffic light alternation.
 Charity road to connect Social club and Abattoir is good to go.

Movement from Abule egba inward Ahmadiyya, ijaiye,Meiran, Alakuko, Kola down to to Ajegunle looks good.

Ajegunle back to Alakuko is good to go via Amje, ijaiye, Ahmadiyya all the way to Abule Egba junction back to abule egba is very encouraging as well.

Jubilee bridge inward Super to ile epo is in good shape, steady vehicular movement from ile  epo to Ogundare junction via Pleasure.

While the  return journey from Pleasure to Ile epo down to Super looks good.
Drive carefully at all time.
It's a wet Wednesday morning.
